## What this adds

This is the foundation PR: a reliable backend before any new UI is wired up.

Business logic now lives in a `server/` layer, APIs delegate to it, and bookings and contact submissions write to the audit log and notification outbox. Several bugs from the initial build are fixed (contact endpoint, soft deletes, API client errors, and others).

## Highlights

- Service layer under `server/` with `server-only` boundaries
- `POST /api/contact` and admin settings/messages APIs
- Audit log and notification inserts on key actions
- Soft-delete fixes, lead scoring, booking status rules
- Lib cleanup: rate limiting, request IDs, typed env, `withAuth`
- Redesign documentation added under `redesign/`

## How to test

1. Run `npm run build`.
2. With PostgreSQL configured, test `POST /api/contact` and `POST /api/bookings` and confirm database rows plus audit and notification records.
3. Confirm soft-deleted testimonials are not returned by ID.

## Note

This merged into `Dev` only. Production release to `main` comes later.
